timeline.descricao: This timeline gathers the main plot events of the first four Metal Gear Solid games, in the order they happen in the story (not in release order). Click a point, use the arrow keys, or play it automatically. Each event links to the matching section of the guide.

sobre.oQue: This site gathers the story of Metal Gear Solid, Metal Gear Solid 2: Sons of Liberty, Metal Gear Solid 3: Snake Eater and Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots, organized by section. You can read each game, save favorite sections (stored in your browser) and follow the plot events on the timeline, with automatic or manual playback.
sobre.fonte: The game content is adapted from English Wikipedia articles, published under the CC BY-SA 4.0 license. The Portuguese translations are derived from those texts and follow the same license.
sobre.imagens: Covers and screenshots belong to their respective rights holders and are shown with credit. Full credits are on the Credits page.
sobre.projeto: This is a fan project, not affiliated with Konami or Hideo Kojima.
